topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I stare at the package, its surface unmarked by any familiar name or hint. The address label stares back, a ghostly remnant of the last tenant. The edges are worn, the tape slightly frayed, as if the box has traveled through time itself, depositing itself at my door by mistake. I trace the letters with a trembling finger, knowing it holds no secret for me, no treasure, no reply to any question I've ever asked. It's a relic from a past I didn't live, a life I didn't choose. The world outside continues to spin, indifferent, as I stand here, clutching a piece of someone else's story.
